model: SensAir toxic / combustible gas detector (BACnet MS/TP option)
equipment_type: Gas detection sensor (fixed toxic / combustible / O2 detector)
applies_to: Sensidyne SensAir fixed gas detectors (O2, H2S, NH3, CO, Cl2, HCl, NO2, H2, HCN, HF, SO2, ClO2, combustible LEL) fitted with the BACnet option board.
summary: With its BACnet option board the SensAir detector is a BACnet MS/TP smart sensor. One AI gives the gas reading (%vol for O2, %LEL for combustibles, ppm for toxics), two AVs hold the alarm setpoints, and eight BVs cover zeroing, calibration status, the two alarm states, latch enable and latched alarms. Sensor faults are reported through the Reliability property of the gas reading.
notes: On the O2 sensor the AV 1, BV 3, BV 5 and BV 7 names change to the Low Low versions (e.g. "Gas Alarm Setpoint Low Low") and track the most urgent (low oxygen) alarm.
AI 1 units follow the sensor: percent for O2 and combustible LEL, ppm for toxic gases; AV 1-2 use the same units.
Gas Concentration Reliability shows NO_SENSOR, PROCESS_ERROR, NO_OUTPUT (maintenance, zeroing or calibrating), OVER/UNDER_RANGE (under range during 60 s warm-up).
With Out_Of_Service true the AI and AVs return a dummy test value that does not affect alarms.
Zeroing is refused on O2 sensors and when the reading is 3 % of full scale or more.
Calibration can only be started at the detector; BV 2 only reports it.

source.title: SensAir Toxic Gas Detector User Manual (section 20, SensAir BACnet Specifications)

integration.summary: Set the address and baud rate on the detector with the magnet switches, then read AI 1 and the two alarm-active BVs; watch the Reliability property of AI 1 for sensor faults. Alarm setpoints and latch mode can be set from the BMS, and latched alarms are cleared by writing inactive to BV 7 or BV 8.

minimum_points.name: High Alarm Active
minimum_points.why: High alarm active (Low Low on O2)

setup: Address 1-127 (default 127) and baud 9600/19200/38400/57600 are set on the detector with the LED display and magnetic switches, not over BACnet.
Device instance = 766 followed by the address (766001-766127).
MS/TP master on 2- or 4-wire RS-485; device name and location are writable (43 characters max).
No alarm/event notification and no DeviceCommunicationControl.
gotchas: Leave Out_Of_Service false on AI 1 in normal use; it switches to a dummy value that does not drive alarms.
AV 1 must stay at or above AV 2 on toxic/combustible sensors (at or below on O2); out-of-range writes are clamped.
Clearing either latched-alarm BV clears both, and only once the gas is back below alarm level.
